_comment: Authoritative text for the audio. scripts.md is the prose version for a human; this is what gets spoken. Keep them in step.

variants.2-contradiction: Two numbers on your medical bill should match. They usually don't.
variants.3-instruction: Before you pay this, there's one number you need to find.

body.text: This is a hospital bill. It wants $845.
This is the Explanation of Benefits — the letter from your insurance, about the same visit. It says you owe $186.35.
Same visit. Same day. Two different numbers.
The difference is $658.65, and it's the discount your insurer already negotiated. The hospital agreed to it when they joined the network.
Your insurance letter isn't a bill — it's telling you what the bill should say. So check they match before you pay.

_numbers: Figures are digits because TTS normalises them correctly and they are less ambiguous to proofread — NOT because spelled-out numbers fail. That was my first conclusion and it was wrong: see the retry note in ../tts.mjs. Empty responses are transient and hit any line.
_scenes: Each beat names a scene in scenes.py (window + what to circle). circleAt is the fraction of the spoken line at which the circle starts being drawn — set it to land on the number as it is said, not before.
